name: Yomise Tokino
source:
Hobbies: Hunting
Skills: Reading books very fast
Likes: Talented people
Dislikes: Stains attached to old clothes

The guardian of the "crowns", and a genius teacher who studied in North America. However, Tokino can be arrogant at times, especially when she meets people with no talents at all.
